g.text: Whole-command recognition: raw prediction and locked acceptance
Official196 includes correct rejections; its accepted score is not a count of accepted positives.
Personal and fresh-voice cohorts are synthetic. Human accuracy excludes 185 ambiguous references.
Candidate not promoted: human UNKNOWN accepts increased from 12/229 to 14/229. Command-only replay; no Pi/live-mic claim.
